mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_note_count (note_id, like_total) VALUES (#{noteId}, #{count}) ON CONFLICT (note_id) DO UPDATE SET like_total = t_note_count.like_total + #{count}
INSERT INTO t_note_count (note_id, collect_total) VALUES (#{noteId}, #{count}) ON CONFLICT (note_id) DO UPDATE SET collect_total = t_note_count.collect_total + #{count}
INSERT INTO t_note_count (note_id, comment_total) VALUES (#{noteId}, GREATEST(0, #{count})) ON CONFLICT (note_id) DO UPDATE SET comment_total = GREATEST(0, t_note_count.comment_total + #{count})
